book_lines.text: When the two photosystems work in a series, first PS II and then the PS I, a process called non-cyclic photo-phosphorylation occurs.
The two photosystems are connected through an electron transport chain, as seen earlier – in the Z scheme.
Both ATP and NADPH + H⁺ are synthesised by this kind of electron flow (Figure 11.5).
